response.sql:
WITH media_rates AS (
  SELECT
    mt.Name AS media_type_name,
    SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.Name
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS average_rate
  FROM media_rates
)
SELECT
  mr.media_type_name,
  mr.byte_rate,
  mr.byte_rate - oa.average_rate AS above_average
FROM media_rates AS mr
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE mr.byte_rate > oa.average_rate;

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded from SUM(Bytes), while their Milliseconds remain in the denominator; media types with linked tracks are included even if all their Bytes are NULL.
Media types sharing the same name are treated as one group, as requested. The overall average is the unweighted average of those grouped rates.

alternatives.interpretation: If a track with NULL Bytes should be omitted from both totals, compute each rate using only tracks with non-NULL Bytes.
alternatives.sql:
WITH media_rates AS (
  SELECT
    mt.Name AS media_type_name,
    SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mt.Name
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS average_rate
  FROM media_rates
)
SELECT
  mr.media_type_name,
  mr.byte_rate,
  mr.byte_rate - oa.average_rate AS above_average
FROM media_rates AS mr
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE mr.byte_rate > oa.average_rate;
